title.zh: 软件工程师（2027 届校招）

location.zh: 湾区 / 纽约 / 西雅图

description.zh: 面向 2027 年毕业的本科与硕士。校友内推可以跳过简历初筛，请先把简历发给内推人。
description.en: For BS/MS graduating in 2027. Alumni referral skips the resume screen — send your resume to the referrer first.

title.zh: Business Analyst（纽约 / 北京 / 上海）

description.zh: 全球统一网申，中国区办公室单独面试。校友可以做一轮 case 模拟，见求职小组。
description.en: Single global application; China offices interview separately. Alumni run case mocks — see study groups.

title.zh: 投行部暑期分析师（香港）

description.zh: 2027 年暑期实习，滚动录取，越早投越好。陈昊校友 9 月组织 superday 模拟。
description.en: Summer 2027, rolling admissions — apply early. Hao Chen hosts a mock superday in September.

title.zh: 算法工程师（2027 届秋招）

location.zh: 北京 / 上海 / 深圳

description.zh: 国内秋招正式批。海外应届生按国内秋招时间线走，注意 8–10 月是黄金投递期。
description.en: China campus recruiting, formal batch. Overseas grads follow the China timeline — Aug–Oct is the window.

location.zh: 纽约 / 伦敦 / 香港

description.zh: 面试以概率、博弈和市场直觉为主。周凯文校友可以做两轮陪练。
description.en: Interviews focus on probability, games and market intuition. Kevin Zhou offers two rounds of practice.

location.zh: 北京 / 上海 / 香港

description.zh: 海外院校单独通道，网申后有 online case。吴承泽校友可以内推并讲解北京办公室情况。
description.en: Separate track for overseas schools with an online case after application. Chengze Wu can refer and brief on the Beijing office.

description.zh: 适合刚毕业或博后阶段的生物 / 化学博士。张宇桐校友可以先聊一下团队再决定投不投。
description.en: Suited to recent bio/chem PhDs or postdocs. Talk to Yutong Zhang about the team before applying.

description.zh: 提供签证担保。黄雅琪校友可以介绍英国毕业生签证与求职节奏。
description.en: Visa sponsorship available. Yaqi Huang can explain UK graduate visas and recruiting rhythm.

title.zh: 创始团队产品经理（上海）

description.zh: 校友创业公司招创始团队成员，现金 + 期权。直接联系刘沐晨校友。
description.en: Alumni-founded startup hiring a founding PM, cash + equity. Contact Muchen Liu directly.

title.zh: 产品经理实习生（2027 暑期）

description.zh: 已截止，保留作为下一年的参考：PM 实习通常 8 月底就关闭。
description.en: Closed. Kept for reference — PM internships typically close by end of August.
